title: A Whale Was Found Carrying an Exploding Harpoon From the 1890s

scenes.text: A whale was found carrying an exploding harpoon from the 1890s.
It was a bomb lance, an explosive shot from a shoulder gun, probably made in New Bedford, Massachusetts.
It was fired around 1890. The whale carried it for well over a century.
Scientists estimated that bowhead was between one hundred fifteen and one hundred thirty years old.
Eye lens dating suggests some bowheads may live past two hundred.
It survived an exploding harpoon, and kept swimming.

description:
In 2007, a fragment of a bomb lance from around 1890 was found inside a bowhead whale caught by hunters.
Scientists estimated the whale was between 115 and 130 years old, and eye lens dating suggests some bowheads may exceed 200.
How old do you think the oldest whale alive is? Comment below.
first_comment: This whale outlived the explosive that hit it by over a century. What is the oldest thing you have ever seen survive?
